messages:
maya: Heads-up — we got a big late-ingest spike from EU (~3.2M events) and the backfill runner prioritized a handful of multi-hour aggregates, which choked the slot pool. Can we tweak routing / priority weighting so small, high-value aggregates get fast passes?

samir: Ugh. Saw that alert. My quick thought: add a size_penalty to the scheduler so cost ~ (estimated_tokens * size_penalty) + staleness_bonus. Small agg -> lower cost -> higher priority.

maya: +1 on size_penalty. Also the console makes it hard to override weights for ad-hoc runs. UX currently only toggles low/med/high. Need a numeric slider or per-run advanced options.

alina: Important to consider multi-tenant fairness. If we just favor small jobs we could starve large-but-critical customers. Can we surface tenant impact in the preflight estimate? e.g., "% of tenant quota used if this run goes to 100%"

samir: Good call. We can compute an "estimated-quota-impact" phantomsheet during dry-run. Implementation sketch:
```
POST /replay/dryrun
{ job_id, window, target_aggregates, priority_overrides }
// response: {est_runtime_ms, est_tokens, est_quota_percent_by_tenant}
```
That output feeds the console preflight modal.

jin: Be cautious with aggressive automatic weighting changes during business hours. Our SLO for online inference increases if backfills steal slots. Suggest: 1) enforce a max_cluster_load threshold; 2) if above threshold, route backfills to low-priority queue or trigger partial-run mode.

maya: Agreed. Proposal: fallback policy = if cluster_util > 0.7 then route runs with est_runtime > 10m to spot/backoff queue. Short runs (<10m) still allowed.

alina: For fairness we should allow tenants to opt into faster reprocessing via a "fast lane" reserved budget (chargeback or contractual). That avoids messing with everyone.

samir: Implementation tasks I see: update scheduler scoring fn (size_penalty + staleness_bonus), add dry-run API returning est_quota metrics, console changes (advanced numeric override + preflight modal), and a new cluster-util gate. Estimated effort: 3 sprint-days backend + 2 frontend.

maya: Can ops carve a week to test in staging? We need a canary with EU-only traffic and a mixed tenant set.

ops-bot: @maya staging job `backfill-canary-eu` started (run id bf-20260320-9). Dry-run completed.

console-bot: Dry-run results: est_runtime=00:08:12, est_tokens=1.2M, est_quota_impact={tenant-a: 4%, tenant-b: 12%}.

jin: Nice — the dry-run numbers look promising for short runs. If we can gate >10m runs behind the cluster-util check, that's a safe start.

alina: For rollout UX: include a dropdown in the preflight modal: [Default priority] [Override numeric weight] [Fast-lane request]. Record the override in audit logs + warn about tenant impact.

samir: Will start a PR for scoring change and dry-run API. Frontend ticket for preflight modal -> @maya can you write acceptance criteria for the modal?

maya: Yup. I'll drop a short spec in the ticket today. Key items: numeric override (0-100), show est_quota_impact, "simulate run" button, and link to tenant fast-lane opt-in page.

jin: One more thing — add a soft quota throttle that responds to sustained high latency. If online latency climbs > p95 SLO, throttles backfill throughput by 2x every 5m until stable.

maya: Good fail-safe. OK team — prioritize scheduler change + dry-run API this sprint, console UX as next sprint. I'll follow up with a staging test plan. :thumbsup:

samir: Sounds good. PR coming in later today.

alina: Thanks all.

maya: Closing loop — recording action items in the replay backlog.
